title: Add conditional prefix supervision without production completion
body:

Every original production function/class source segment and the production parent/mint route remain exact. V1 self-hash/capture rejections, initial fixture failures, earlier close model, repair/bill/policy requirements and final independent reviews are preserved.

This is a conditional source contribution. No genuine capability or runtime policy is supplied. The initial 12/repaired 13-file assembly is not deployable closure. Authenticated enclosing-parent pre-import bootstrap, actual transitive receiver policy/module identities and 48-module/512-global fit, compiler-input closure/C07/native/stage/command/funding/currentness/runtime admission and actual parent exit remain absent.
